dataset.name: Ontave supplier-quotation application benchmark
dataset.origin: Original fictional English quotations; no customer documents or external benchmark data
dataset.scope: Text-only supplier assertions and controlled storage/review workflows. No OCR, PDF parsing, bank verification or official DocILE score.
dataset.split: 8 development documents and 16 held-out supplier/layout/scenario families; holdout is maintainer-authored, not an independent external test set

protocol.developmentChanges: Two acquisitions halted after their first provider HTTP 400. Replaced optional-property-heavy provider schema with a generic claim map; the host retains the same closed domain validation, fields, instructions, labels and scoring. Failed acquisitions and diagnostics retained.
protocol.pairedDesign: One acquired prediction is replayed into both arms. Raw extraction accuracy is shared, not a claimed framework uplift.
protocol.scoring: One-to-one type/quotation/SKU/field/normalized-value match with verbatim source containment; extra fields are false positives, missing or failed documents retain all expected fields as misses. Empty documents evaluated separately. Raw and accepted-data results separate.
protocol.humanEffort: Pending real participant sessions; machine timings, scripted decisions and code counts are separate.
protocol.externalBenchmark: DocILE is a reference method. Dataset access and official evaluator run remain pending. No official DocILE score.
protocol.statistics: 95% family-cluster bootstrap; repeated trials stay in document-family cluster. Wilson intervals for binary document outcomes.
